newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA'S TSYMBALAR OUT FOR TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA'S TSYMBALAR OUT FOR TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Spartak Moscow captain and international midfielder Ilya Tsymbalar will be out for two months with a knee injury and may face surgery, a club spokesman said on Friday.
Spokesman Alexander Lvov said Tsymbalar, 27, had picked up the injury in Spartak's 2-1 league defeat against KamAZ Naberezhniye Chelny on April 19.
"A medical examination has revealed that Tsymbalar's meniscus is damaged and doctors say the treatment will take two months. Surgery is not ruled out", Lvov said.
The injury forces Tsymbalar out of Russia's World Cup qualifier against Luxembourg next Wednesday.
Lvov said a European club had shown an interest in buying Tsymbalar but gave no details.
